title: Zonal Merchant Lead
description:
* Sales & Distribution Management
* Merchant acquisition in the circle
* Apt knowledge of the geography to support deployment of resources for merchant business.
* Merchant activation (Small Merchants & Large format retail)
* Ensure Visibility in the market place for the brand
* Supporting cross functional teams to ensure merchant business growth

* Planning & execution of strategies related to merchant for the circles to ensure deliverables related to merchant acquisition, Activation, unique customers & throughput are met as per the plan

* Keeping the management updated about the competition and developing strategies for winning in the market
